items.title: USN-9153-1: cloud-init vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that cloud-init incorrectly handled certain errors when configuring user passwords on systems with SSSD installed but not configured. An attacker could possibly use this issue to access affected user accounts without a password, resulting in unauthorized access.

items.title: USN-9152-1: GStreamer vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that GStreamer incorrectly handled certain malformed data. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code.
